versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "legal-verify" skill for verifying legal citations in text.
- Automatically extracts and checks references to regulations, statutes, and cases against authoritative sources for semantic accuracy and validity.
- Provides clear output judgments ("准确", "时效风险", "语义不一致", "未命中") along with source content and request details.
- Validates the effectiveness and timeliness of cited legal texts; flags risks for expired or inconsistent references.
- Ensures only authoritative source texts are shown—avoids hallucination or fabrication of statutes and cases.
- Includes API key handling and response/error management for seamless integration.
